an3.105:1.1: no cedaṃ bhikkhave, loke assādo abhavissa, nayidaṃ sattā loke sārajjeyyuṃ.
an3.105:1.2: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, atthi loke assādo, tasmā sattā loke sārajjanti.
an3.105:1.3: no cedaṃ bhikkhave, loke ādīnavo abhavissa, nayidaṃ sattā loke nibbindeyyuṃ.
an3.105:1.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, atthi loke ādīnavo, tasmā sattā loke nibbindanti.
an3.105:1.5: no cedaṃ bhikkhave, loke nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa, nayidaṃ sattā lokamhā nissareyyuṃ.
an3.105:1.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, atthi loke nissaraṇaṃ, tasmā sattā lokamhā nissaranti.
an3.105:1.7: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, sattā lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ na abbhaññāsuṃ, neva tāva bhikkhave, sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā-sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaññuttā vippamuttā vimariyādīkatena cetasā vihariṃsu.
an3.105:1.8: yato ca kho bhikkhave, sattā lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsuṃ, atha bhikkhave, sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā-sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaññuttā vippamuttā vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharantīti.
